name: Dual Momentum - Bond Universe + 8% Vol Target
description: Dual Momentum (relative momentum ranking + absolute-momentum cash filter, top-N selection) applied to the fixed-income universe (US Treasuries, USD-hedged global aggregate, global high yield, EUR govt bonds, India INR govt bonds), scaled to 8% annualised volatility. Combines relative and absolute momentum signals across bonds with vol overlay for reduced cash-drag volatility management.
